description: Go repos: tidy go.mod after updates, bump the go directive, and track golangci-lint and go install pins

packageRules.description: Bump the go.mod go directive; the default range strategy treats it as a minimum and never moves it. Libraries that want a low floor can override rangeStrategy locally
Major updates of indirect modules come with a direct dependency's own update, not on their own

customManagers.description: Track pinned go install commands in shell scripts
Track GOLANGCI_VERSION envs in GitHub Actions workflows
